 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Constance Picaud-Inconnu gets away with one there. She saves Kerstin Casparij's effort but parries the ball straight back into the danger zone. Luckily for her, there was no sign of Khadija Shaw waiting to pounce.

 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 Image source, Getty Images Melvine Malard did so well to get in front of Rion Ishikawa at the back post. Got in on her blind side and just pushed it past the post.
 She was the person Chelsea wanted on the end of that. She's hit the ground running as a Chelsea player and is the one that wants to get into the box and score.

 CLOSE! published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Melvine Malard probably should do better there. It's on a plate from Katie McCabe and Malard gets in front of her marker, but she nods wide from two yards out.

 Post published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Ooh. Ayaka Yamashita probably had it covered, but Katie Zelem certainly caught that. The ball falls to her as Manchester City clear their lines, but her shot on the half-volley from 25 yards out rifles wide.

 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Sophia Hartley 
BBC Radio 5 Live at the Joie Stadium 
 City playing some lovely stuff here, really easy on the eye. West Ham defending deeply. You do wonder if the visitors can keep this up for 90 minutes.
 11 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:02 GMT 13:02 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 Good organisation from Everton - keeping their line disciplined.
 Ellie Carpenter is the threat down the right-hand side but Katie McCabe is waving her hands to say there's tons of space down the left.
 Everton will be happy with that as they are dealing with the threat on the right at the moment.

 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Kelly Gago races through on goal as the visitors counter but Yui Hasegawa rushes to get back and does just enough to make sure the West Ham striker can't get a shot away.

 Post published at 13:00 GMT 13:00 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 I'm not sure if it was a cross or a shot from Ellie Carpenter, but it wasn't far off the mark and the ball fires into the side netting.

 Post published at 12:59 GMT 12:59 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Lovely from Manchester City. From Lauren Hemp, to Khadija Shaw, flicked on to Aoba Fujino. The delivery in from Kerstin Casparij just lacks the quality and the attack fizzles out.

 Post published at 12:57 GMT 12:57 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Everton are having a bit of luck pushing forward, but former Chelsea defender Hannah Blundell overhits a cross and it filters all the way through without finding one of her team-mates.
 Promising signs for the Toffees, though.

 YELLOW CARD published at 12:56 GMT 12:56 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Our first yellow card of the game as Rebecca Knaak mistimes a tackle and clatters into Ines Belloumou, who crumples to the floor.

 Post published at 12:54 GMT 12:54 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Lauren Hemp latches onto a loose West Ham pass and she quickly lays it off for Khadija Shaw, who turns and takes aim form the edge of the box but she drags her shot wide.

 get involved Get Involved published at 12:53 GMT 12:53 GMT

 It will be interesting to see how Chelsea fare without LJ for a few weeks due to injury. I think they will be able to cope better than Man City if they were to lose their star player Bunny Shaw.
 James, Herts

 Post published at 12:51 GMT 12:51 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 Lauren Hemp sets Aoba Fujino on her way down the left flank and Khadija Shaw makes her run into the box, but the Japanese international can't get enough curl on her cross and it's easily intercepted by West Ham.

 Sophia Hartley 
BBC Radio 5 Live at the Joie Stadium 
 The Joie Stadium looking rather fabulous on this crisp sunny winter's day. A beautiful day to come watch the footy. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 13 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Toffee's troubles published at 12:49 GMT 12:49 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Since Scott Phelan took charge in January, only Arsenal and Chelsea have kept more clean sheets than Everton.
 However, Toffees keeper Courtney Brosnan has only kept one clean sheet against Chelsea in the WSL.
 The Republic of Ireland international has conceded 43 goals in 12 league appearances against Chelsea - more than twice as many as any other opponent.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Ellie Carptenter makes one of her darting runs up the right wing, but her cross in is blocked and Everton clear the danger.

Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 Everton will look to frustrate Chelsea for as long as possible.
 For Chelsea, if they can get an early goal, knowing Everton aren't really prolific at the moment, it will put a spanner in the works. I'm expecting a fast start from Chelsea.
